description: This file implements variable comparison, cloning, and cleanup functions for the SLAP (Service Logic Aggregation Plane) framework, specifically for the SlapVarHelper component. It defines functions to compare two variables, clone a variable, and clean up a variable, handling various data types and arrays specified within the SLAP framework.

methods.name: BOOL SlapVhoEqualVariables(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE slap_variable1,ANSC_HANDLE slap_variable2)
methods.description: Compares two SLAP variables for equality based on their syntax and contained data, returning TRUE if they are equal, FALSE otherwise.

methods.name: void SlapVhoCloneVariable(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE src_variable,ANSC_HANDLE dst_variable)
methods.description: Clones a SLAP variable from source to destination, copying all relevant data and handling deep copies for complex types.

methods.name: void SlapVhoCleanVariable(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE slap_variable)
methods.description: Cleans a SLAP variable, freeing allocated memory associated with its components based on its syntax.
